evals.prompt: Prepare this week's self-improvement portfolio review. The history API supports an uncapped --all query with an exhaustion receipt, three tickets were admitted this week, and two older tickets are still monitoring delayed outcomes.
evals.expected_output: Binds a cutoff; uses --area self_improvement --all and requires receipt.exhausted=true; includes the two older live packets; reads ticket, program, progress, Reward, artifacts, and prior checkpoint; writes one dated report and preserves missing outcomes as pending
assertions: Proves the exact-area query is uncapped and exhausted before applying the cutoff
Writes a dated checkpoint without mutating ticket truth

evals.prompt: A completed ticket uses an internal harness KPI, but its admission receipt is missing and its area derivation is ambiguous. Reconcile it in the weekly learning review.
evals.expected_output: Records an area/source gap instead of silently treating the ticket as canonical self_improvement membership; cites the ticket as contextual evidence only; does not invent a Reward decision or rewrite its metadata
assertions: Does not infer canonical membership from KPI alone
Records the missing receipt as a source gap
Preserves ticket metadata and Reward state

evals.prompt: A prompt-quality experiment passed its local acceptance check. It was marked as enabling subscriptions, but no subscription source has refreshed yet. Summarize the outcome.
evals.expected_output: Records the leading/enabler result while keeping active-subscription movement pending or source_gap; does not count the local pass as a subscription increase; preserves the future external check-in
assertions: Keeps the local enabler result distinct from ultimate KPI movement
Requires external subscription evidence for realized movement
Does not convert missing evidence to zero or acceptance

evals.prompt: The interval contains nine useful signals, including duplicates and conflicts. Finish the weekly review and hand off what should happen next.
evals.expected_output: Records all qualified and deprioritized signals with evidence and verdicts; emits the report as planner_context_ref; creates no executable skill calls or tickets; leaves normal configured-skill binding, capacity-derived wave_size, admission, and Pulse materialization to their owners
assertions: Keeps all reviewed signals without a target-five quota
Passes only bounded current context to normal planning
Creates no skill calls, tickets, execution, or materialization

evals.prompt: One delayed experiment became due yesterday, but its evidence provider is unavailable and the ticket has no terminal decision. Complete the weekly checkpoint.
evals.expected_output: Marks the row due_checkin_pending with the source gap and next safe owner; does not score, check in, or decide the Reward; retains the packet in the live portfolio and blocks only dependent/conflicting opportunity signals
assertions: Leaves check-in and Reward decision to the ticket worker and Pulse
